$comment: ANTI-mirror map for backend/fleet <-> frontend/lib/fleet (openspec:
migrate-fleet-to-continuous-burns, tasks.md 9.8 — backend/fleet is Go-only
server logic with no TypeScript mirror; fixtures/fleet/cases.json's
commandedAccelRejection family (tasks.md 4.11) is asserted only across the
Go build-target matrix, per its own '_meta.jsRuntimeLeg' field. This file
is what wires that family into
.claude/scripts/check-mirror-map.sh's coverage sweep — mirroring
fixtures/space/mirror-map.json and fixtures/system/mirror-map.json, the
two existing anti-mirror maps.
This is the INVERSE of fixtures/board/mirror-map.json and
fixtures/polar/mirror-map.json. Those assert a mirror EXISTS and is
covered. This one asserts a mirror does NOT exist: check-mirror-map.sh's
anti_mirror pass over this map fails if any function name is declared in
BOTH backend/fleet and frontend/lib/fleet unless it is listed in
'sharedNames'. There is deliberately no 'pairs' array — a pairs entry
would assert the very mirror this designation forbids.
frontend/lib/fleet does not exist as of migrate-fleet-to-continuous-burns
(frontend/lib/types/fleet.ts and frontend/lib/services/fleet-service.ts
are the wire-shape/apiClient layer, not a computed-math mirror package of
the same shape as lib/board or lib/polar), so the anti_mirror check
currently passes trivially on the 'TS_DIR does not exist' branch. Should a
frontend/lib/fleet ever be created for rule-bearing math (as opposed to
wire types), that is the moment this map's anti-mirror designation needs
re-litigating, not silently satisfied.
'sharedNames' is empty BY DEFAULT and should stay that way. Adding a name
here is a claim that a render-side function may legitimately share a name
with an authoritative Go one; it needs the same scrutiny as a spec change.
